# KAHRELUM

> KAHRELUM OS is an evidence-to-decision system for independent, operator-assisted retrospective AI decision review, structured research and evidence-locked forecasting. Claims are bounded by the published evidence and scope.

## Primary commercial services

- [AI and Agent Assurance](https://kahrelum.com/assurance): Independent, fixed-scope historical AI and agent decision reviews.
- [Historical AI Decision Review / Pilot Inquiry](https://kahrelum.com/pilot): $750 upfront Fit Check covering one workflow and three permissioned, appropriately de-identified historical decisions, with a target of two business days after agreed scope, inputs and cleared payment. The full $750 is credited toward the $2,500 Founding Pilot if commenced within 14 days. The $2,500 upfront Founding Pilot covers one workflow and up to ten historical decisions, with a five-business-day target after scope/protocol freeze and approved inputs and cleared payment.
- [Free Decision Evidence Gap Scorecard](https://kahrelum.com/evidence-scorecard): Browser-only, three historical cases and eight PASS/GAP/UNKNOWN review controls, with local CSV export.
- [Synthetic sample deliverable](https://kahrelum.com/sample): An illustrative decision record, not a customer engagement.
- [Synthetic worked example](https://kahrelum.com/demo): A prerecorded, synthetic demonstration, not independently demonstrated client performance.

## Method and published evidence

- [KAHRELUM OS and method](https://kahrelum.com/os): Evidence, alternatives, adversarial challenge, decision, and audit trail.
- [Benchmark record and limitations](https://github.com/AuroraGrid/kahrelum-os/blob/main/BENCHMARKS.md): Retrospective protocols, scores, comparator results, intervals and caveats.
- [External adversarial audit summary](https://github.com/AuroraGrid/kahrelum-os/blob/main/evidence/EXTERNAL_AUDIT_SUMMARY.md): Frozen input and reproducibility record, not a claim of universal commercial superiority.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/AuroraGrid/kahrelum-os): Source files and documented evidence boundaries.

## Public research divisions

- [Forecasting and intelligence](https://kahrelum.com/forecasting): Date-bound election, geopolitical and sports forecasts and evaluation methods.
- [Investigations and OSINT](https://kahrelum.com/investigations): Dated public-record research; allegations are distinguished from established facts.
- [Worldwide Digital Identity Watch](https://kahrelum.com/digital-id): Country-by-country source and legal-status tracking; unassessed areas remain NOT ASSESSED.
- [KAHRELUM ONE](https://kahrelum.com/one): Concept in development, not an available production application.

## Engagement and evidence boundaries

No client results claimed. No certification, guaranteed outcomes, production access, live third-party testing, or licensed private-investigation service is offered by these fixed-scope packages. Do not transmit confidential records, customer identifiers, private prompts, credentials or other restricted information through the public inquiry. Payment is arranged only after written scope, data-handling and eligibility confirmation; there is no immediate checkout.

Contact: [Pilot inquiry](https://kahrelum.com/pilot#request) or hasan@kahrelum.com.
